text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: All those petty schemes have been seen through in their entirety. From here on, no tricks are needed—only blades crossed head-on—
text_block_list.orig_text:
小賢しき策謀の数々、
悉く看破いたし候。
此処より先は虚仮も無用、
正面より刃を交えるのみ──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: A pure, straightforward clash, a true “serious battle,” let us proceed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
純然たる真っ向勝負、
『がちばとる』と参りましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Our foe is a legendary monster, kin to dragons. They will not be easily overcome—however.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手は伝説の魔物、
竜の眷属。
一筋縄ではいきません──
といっても。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: That is only if they were not facing us. Even so.
text_block_list.orig_text:
我らが相手でなければ。
であるが。
